messages.author: 9db45410fcb5a5d4
messages.subject: Cannot use Renjin from Eclipse
parts:
Hi,

I downloaded "renjin-studio-0.7.0-RC7-jar-with-dependencies.jar" and added it to my libraries.

I use the following code:
----
import javax.script.ScriptEngine;
import javax.script.ScriptEngineManager;
import javax.script.ScriptException;

public class RProvider {

public static final ScriptEngine getREngine() throws ScriptException {
ScriptEngine engine = new ScriptEngineManager()
.getEngineByName("Renjin");
if (engine == null) {
throw new ScriptException("Could not find R-engine");
}
return engine;
}

public static void main(String[] args) throws ScriptException {
// Test Renjin
ScriptEngine r = RProvider.getREngine();
r.eval("df <- data.frame(x=1:10, y=(1:10)+rnorm(n=10))");
r.eval("print(df)");
}
}
----
The engine could not be found. For testing purpose I tried adding it as first element to export as well....

Thanks for helping beginner,

Florian

messages.author: 3b104dc6686d0c85
messages.subject: Re: Cannot use Renjin from Eclipse
parts:
Hi Florian,

the various components that come with Renjin can be a bit confusing. To use the script engine, you need the renjin-script-engine-0.7.0-RC7-jar-with-dependencies.jar, not renjin-studio. You can download it from here: http://build.bedatadriven.com/job/renjin/lastSuccessfulBuild/org.renjin$renjin-script-engine/

Good luck!

Maarten-Jan
